title: Red Hat Security Advisory: nginx:1.24 security update
description: Multiple critical security vulnerabilities have been identified in the nginx 1.24 module used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support. These include use-after-free conditions in the resolver, HTTP/2 worker process, and mail proxy server, a flow control window overflow in HTTP/2, and a denial of service via crafted TLS connections. Red Hat has released an update addressing these issues.
